definitions.branch_count: Biological axes beginning at forks, excluding trunk. Collapse degree-two chains; choose thickest child as axis continuation, tie-break by stable node index.
definitions.branch_order: Trunk order 0; continuing dominant axis retains order, lateral at fork increases it by one.
definitions.crown_base_m: Lowest retained foliage Y above ground; report live primary-branch insertion separately. Hanging foliage and branch insertion are different.
definitions.crown_width_m: Maximum of X and Z retained-foliage AABB spans; also report both spans. Approximation to field maximum spread; do not use wood buttress or envelope width.
definitions.dbh_m: Diameter at 1.3 m above root ground along dominant trunk, interpolating intersecting structural edge radii; report 2*radius as circular-equivalent centreline model proxy. Multi-stem at this plane is ambiguous and must be flagged, not summed. Sources using US breast height (~1.37 m) are approximate comparisons; retain measurement height.
definitions.foliage_length_m: For ash, the whole pinnate leaf, base of the lowest leaflet pair to the terminal leaflet tip, excluding the woody attachment. Leaflet length is a separate field. A simple-blade stand-in is not this measurement.
definitions.foliage_units: Ash: one pinnate leaf is one placement; leaflets are instances. Report placements, instances and units_per_instance. A simple blade is not an ash leaf.
definitions.foliage_width_m: Maximum width of the whole pinnate leaf across opposite leaflet pairs. Leaflet width is not this field.
definitions.height_m: Maximum Y of actual wood/retained foliage above root ground Y=0; exclude root flare below ground. Also report wood-only height. Envelope height is a parameter, not a measurement.
definitions.leaf_area_m2: Sum transformed triangle areas once per leaflet sheet; do not double for double-sided rendering.
definitions.leaflet_count: Number of leaflets on one leaf, including the terminal leaflet. Typical 7-13; one leaf is one placement and its leaflets are instances.
definitions.leaflet_length_m: Base-to-tip of one leaflet lamina, excluding the rachis.
definitions.twig_count: Unique retained twig runs (NodeKind::Twig), each a terminal fine woody axis; does not imply one leaf.

anatomy.attachment: Opposite (decussate) pairs; one leaflet of a pair may be displaced. Not alternate simple blades.
anatomy.branching: Round-headed, broad-spreading open crown; grey bark smooth then furrowed; opposite twigs.
anatomy.element: Opposite pinnate compound leaf, 7-13 sessile serrate leaflets on a rachis, terminal leaflet present, black winter buds. One leaf is one placement; leaflets are instances. Unsupported until fn-33.

capability_matrix.opposite-attachment: unmet as a paired station; divergence 180 is not opposite pairing

profiles.context: Mature tree-form, healthy leaf-on, open-grown European parkland or woodland-edge; not a golden-leaf cultivar, not a dieback-killed skeleton. Profile and references are complete. The template waits for fn-33 compound leaves; a simple-blade fixture is not a passing species (R4).

crown_width_height_ratio.note: Engineering estimate from OSU equal-or-greater width. Labelled estimate.

crown_width_m.note: OSU: equal or somewhat greater width than height, round-headed and broad spreading. Contextual until the template lands.

dbh_m.note: Dobrowolska & Kowalczyk 2020: forest dominant/codominant mean DBH about 0.22-0.50 m at 48-120 years. Open-grown trees can be thicker. Not a pass claim until the template lands.

foliage_length_m.note: Whole pinnate leaf. Thomas to 30 cm; OSU 25-30 cm; Kew 20-25 cm. A simple-blade fixture cannot meet this as an ash leaf.

foliage_units.note: Metrics must report placements, instances and units per instance once compound leaves exist.

foliage_width_m.note: No cited whole-leaf width distribution; leaflet width is not this field.

height_m.note: OSU landscape to 25(30+) m; Kew to 40 m; Baltic forestry dominant/codominant 22-30 m at 50-120 years. Thomas 2016 British woodland typical 12-18 m is contextual and is not substituted. Exceptional 40-43 m is not gated.

leaf_area_m2.note: Thomas cites Grime, Hodgson & Hunt 2007: typically << 5000 mm2 per leaf. Not converted into a gate.

leaflet_count.note: Thomas up to 13; OSU 7-11; Kew 9-13. One leaf is one placement; leaflets are instances.

leaflet_length_m.note: OSU leaflets 5-10 cm; Thomas usually c. 7 cm. Units-per-instance target once fn-33 lands.

reference_height_by_age.note: Recorded target for a future template. Not used: the ash is not a catalogue species.

rubric.crown_silhouette: Round-headed, as wide as tall or wider; A-WHOLE.
rubric.foliage_shape_attachment: Pinnate compound, opposite; A-LEAF, A-SHOOT. A simple blade fails this trait.
